QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_3

question.text: The Investment Manager of Banyan Tree Longshort AIF (Category III) is benchmarking fee economics versus peers. As per Ch 9 of the NISM workbook, the typical management fee range is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Category III AIF management fees are charged as a fixed percentage, generally in the range of 1% to 2.5% of Gross NAV. With scale, managers may compress fixed fees towards the 1% to 1.75% band. The Trap: Option A is too low and closer to mutual-fund expense-ratio caps. Options B and D are unrealistically high for regulated AIFs. Note: The 1% to 2.5% GNAV management-fee range is set out in the fee chapter of the workbook for Category III AIFs.
